seed_ledger.name: Socorro power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: ONSITE_NO_PIPE: Atlas Energy Solutions signed a five-year power agreement for a 120 MW private plant at Socorro, Texas, reportedly for the Wiwynn factories. It is off-grid and run on gas engines. The GOGPT notes cite a TCEQ review calling it behind-the-meter. No source says where the gas comes from, and no new pipe was found. Wiwynn makes data center equipment, so the data center tie is also weak. The El Paso Meta lateral (P8316) is a different site. Searches run: 8. Checked: Atlas 8-K of March 2026 (power agreement, energization first half of 2027, no gas supply stated); El Paso Times and Reuters syndication on Wiwynn (120 MW off-grid plant replacing 13 portable generators, no gas source); Aterio listing (gas reciprocating engines, early 2027); TCEQ public notices and permit search (nothing found); EIA, FERC, Railroad Commission and county records (nothing found).

evidence.note: Atlas 8-K, five-year power purchase agreement, energization first half of 2027, no gas supply named
